title: Generators of II₁ factors
author: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic)
description: Every II₁ factor with separable predual is generated by one operator, equivalently by two self-adjoint operators (OpenAI, 2026). Haar unitaries and freeness of a unitary from a C*-algebra in tracial von Neumann algebras; tracial ultraproducts; Popa's free independence theorem for irreducible inclusions, proved by patching partial isometries with local quantization in corners; Haagerup's inequality for words of length one and a perturbation of a unitary whose correlation with a fixed vector stays uniform along long words; relative generation W*(P,u) = M for a dense G_δ set of unitaries u; irreducible hyperfinite subfactors, two self-adjoint generators of the hyperfinite factor and a 2×2 matrix encoding.
prerequisites: Course foundations-of-von-neumann-algebras (double commutant and Kaplansky density theorems, polar decomposition, comparison of projections, spectral projections, preduals, Baire and Banach–Alaoglu)
Course type-iii-factors, lesson on ultraproducts (Theorems 3.2, 3.3, Lemma 1.4: tracial ultraproducts)
OA-SUBFACTORS lesson finite-phase-local-quantization (Lemma 55.1, Theorem 55.7: local quantization)
OA-APPROX lessons abelian-pinching-and-relative-commutants (Lemma 3.1), masas-in-expected-semifinite-subfactors (Theorem 2.1) and infinite-tensor-products (Corollary 5.3)

checks.exact_checks: python: the multiplicity identity sum n_p^2 = 2l^2 - l for the elements g_k g_j^(-1) of a free group, l <= 40; the combinatorial constants of the patching theorem in exact rational arithmetic for word lengths k <= 15 (sum over |S| >= 2 at most (11/32 + 1/3) eps_k, total 77/96 < 1); recovery of 12 commuting projections from one weighted sum (200 random trials); the 2x2 encoding generates M_6(C) from random a_1..a_4 in M_3(C); the length-one Haagerup bound on the radius-6 ball of F_2; and a random-matrix test of the perturbation estimate with N = 500 Haar unitaries in place of free ones (||h||_2 = alpha/sqrt(2l) and correlation (alpha/2) tau(xi* z) within the bound) (scratch gen_checks.py) (8 Oct 2026)

open_obligations: Single generation of every von Neumann algebra with separable predual (consequence in OpenAI-Gen): needs Willig's direct-integral reduction to II_1 factors (Tohoku Math. J. 26, 1974), Pearcy's type I case (Proc. AMS 13, 1962) and Wogen's properly infinite case (Bull. AMS 75, 1969); not yet proved in the programme.

Vanishing of the generator invariants G(M) = G_sa(M) = 0 for II_1 factors with separable predual (consequence in OpenAI-Gen): needs Dykema-Sinclair-Smith-White, Corollary 5.1 and Theorem 5.5 (arXiv 0706.1953); not yet proved in the programme.

For n >= 3, L(F_n) has two finite self-adjoint generating tuples with different microstates free entropy dimensions delta and delta_0 (consequence in OpenAI-Gen): needs Voiculescu's free entropy dimension and its value n on semicircular n-tuples; not yet proved in the programme.
free_sources: OpenAI, Relative generation and the generator problem for finite factors (preprint, 23 Sep 2026)
Popa, Independence properties in subalgebras of ultraproduct II_1 factors (arXiv 1308.3982)
